resolved_intent.raw_question: A101空压机最近一周单位产量能耗为什么增加？

sql_executed: SELECT device_id AS machine_id, device_code AS machine_code, device_name AS machine_name, device_type AS machine_type FROM mysql_mes.production.device_master WHERE device_code = 'A101' OR device_name = 'A101' OR device_id = 'A101' LIMIT 10

WITH
m_energy_consumption AS (
  SELECT SUM(t.energy_kwh) AS value
  FROM internal.industrial_ai.energy_5min t
  WHERE t.machine_id = (SELECT device_id FROM mysql_mes.production.device_master WHERE device_code = 'A101' OR device_name = 'A101' OR device_id = 'A101' LIMIT 1) AND t.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
),
m_production_output AS (
  SELECT SUM(t.good_qty) AS value
  FROM mysql_mes.production.production_hourly t
  WHERE t.device_id = (SELECT device_id FROM mysql_mes.production.device_master WHERE device_code = 'A101' OR device_name = 'A101' OR device_id = 'A101' LIMIT 1) AND t.stat_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
)
SELECT (m_energy_consumption.value / NULLIF(m_production_output.value, 0)) AS metric_value, 'kWh/piece' AS metric_unit
FROM m_energy_consumption, m_production_output

response.answer: A101 最近一周单位产量能耗约为 0.124 kWh/piece，相对基线 0.104 kWh/piece 上升 19.23%。结合告警和维修事件，最值得优先验证的原因是过滤器阻力增加导致压缩机负载上升。近期开启最多的异常为“Filter Differential Pressure High”，共 7 次；同时出现“Discharge Temperature High” 3 次；历史工单记录显示过滤器压差已上升，但当时仅检查、未更换。建议现场先检查过滤器压差、吸气阻力和排气温度，再与正常工况下的加载率/卸载率对比。
